top_signals.title: CK Hutchison Profit Jumps Sharply on Oil, Retail Strength
top_signals.summary: CK Hutchison Holdings Ltd.’s profit rose sharply in the first half of the year, as the conglomerate’s investment in oil production paid off amid a global energy shock that fueled price hikes.
